Who is HSBC Innovation Banking? We're the power behind the UK's forward-thinkers, future-makers and leap-takers, helping them ignite the bold ideas that reshape our world. We offer flexible banking solutions for start-ups, scale-ups, growth businesses, investors and those working towards IPO. Whether it's comprehensive corporate banking, managing cashflow, plans for buyouts or funds banking, we power ideas at every stage of their journey. From the first-time founders to the funds that back them and everything in between. Here's to never standing still. We're proud to accelerate growth for tech and life science businesses, create meaningful connections and open a world of global opportunity for entrepreneurs and investors alike. The programme The 18-month graduate programme is designed to build the core skills you need for a successful career in corporate banking. You'll be challenged, supported and given opportunities to broaden your capabilities while working alongside colleagues with deep expertise and a shared commitment to supporting our clients. You'll also have a dedicated mentor and buddy to support you throughout the programme. You'll work within the HSBC Innovation Banking Chief Commercial Office, partnering with experts in the Treasury & Trade Solutions product sales team. The London-based team is responsible for the positioning of commercial banking solutions to the innovation economy. The suite of products includes Cards, Digital Channels, Liquidity, Payments, Trade Finance and Integration solutions. The Treasury & Trade Solutions pathway provides a significant amount of hands-on activity with the client base and product inventory that you are supporting, potentially working with clients across a range of different sectors and life stages. You will work with and support senior sales specialists and relationship teams to position Cards, Cash Management, Payments, Liquidity, Digital Channels, Trade Finance and Integration solutions for clients in the innovation economy. You can expect meaningful, hands-on experience with the clients you support. Alongside this, you'll take part in training designed to build the knowledge and practical skills you need to succeed. Topics include:

- Client positioning, negotiation and portfolio management
- Innovation Banking product suite and sales strategies
- The innovation ecosystem and venture capital funding cycles
- Data analysis and senior stakeholder management.

- You have a genuine interest in innovation, particularly technology and life sciences.
- You enjoy solving problems, welcome a challenge and are willing to explore new approaches. When you don't know the answer, you take the initiative to find it.

- You have, or expect to obtain, a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification. Previous work experience is welcome but not required.

We're looking for talented individuals who bring initiative, creativity, and curiosity to the table. In return, you'll gain valuable hands-on experience, receive mentorship from some of the industry's best and earn recognised professional qualification.
By the end of your GraduateProgramme, you'll be a well-rounded, commercially minded professional, ready to take on interesting and challenging responsibilities. You won't just be fully qualified - you'll be fully prepared to drive your own career forward.
What Sets Us Apart
At MHA, people come first, our colleagues, our clients, and the communities we support. In 2026, we ranked as number 11 in the UK's top accountancy firms and a proud member of Baker Tilly International, the world's 8th largest network, we combine global insight with a strong local commitment.
Our people-centred approach is what truly makes us different. You will be welcomed as a valued member of a collaborative, purpose-led team. We are committed to continuous learning, growth, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive and be themselves.
We are proud to hold the Investors in People Gold award, recognising our commitment to supporting, developing, and valuing every individual.
Here,You'llGo Beyond Numbers
We are looking for a Corporate Finance Analystto join us who is comfortable in an evolving environment and enjoys solving a variety of challenges that contribute to meaningful outcomes.
At MHA, you will be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to making a difference. Your work in Corporate Finance will go beyond the numbers, we believe in hands-on learning. You'll be doing real work on real projects, not just shadowing.
While you'll receive mentorship and guidance, we prefer you to learn through extensive and practical on-the-job training.
Corporate Finance is a varied and commercially focused career where you'll help businesses make some of their most important decisions. You could support clients looking to buy or sell a business, raise finance, secure investment or plan the next stage of their growth. No two projects are the same, giving you the opportunity to work with a wide range of organisations, industries and people.
From an early stage, you'll build relationships with clients and work closely with experienced colleagues across MHA. You'll ask questions, gather financial and commercial information, research businesses and markets, and contribute to reports and presentations for clients. You'll also develop your analytical skills and commercial awareness, helping you understand what drives a successful business and identify the information that matters.
You don't need to arrive knowing everything. We're looking for people who are curious, willing to learn and comfortable working collaboratively. If you enjoy understanding how businesses work and grow, analysing information, solving problems and working with different people on a variety of projects, Corporate Finance could be a great fit for you.
As a Corporate Finance Analyst, you'll experience the power of collaboration as you work with diverse teams on real projects, build lasting connections with colleagues and start off by learning the fundamentals, including:
• Analysing financial information;
• Assisting with the development and drafting of reports and business planning documentation;
• Conducting detailed market research and analysis;
• Attending client meetings and developing relationships; and
• Assisting with the efficient project management of transaction processes.
• Studying towards Professional Qualification (ACA Level 7)

Rewards That Resonate
You're more than a number to us; you're someone with unique skills and aspirations. Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, foster your professional growth, and recognise the contribution you make.
• Agile working: Our flexible working policy gives you greater choice over how you structure your day. With core hours of 10am-2pm, you can start earlier or finish later to suit your needs, alongside the option to work from home up to two days a week. For trainees, we ask for full office attendance during the first six months to ensure you receive the training, support and experience needed for a strong start, with greater flexibility available after that.
• 30days'holiday, including bank holidays, plus the opportunity to buy or sell up to 5 days (28 days on a training contract, with the opportunity to buy 5 days).
• Full study support package:including exams, tuition, study leave days and materials.
• Employee recognition awards:Performance Award bonus and other recognition initiatives.
• Employee Assistance Programme: A free, confidential 24-hour support service, including unlimited counselling sessions and access to virtual doctors for you and your family.
• And lots more!

Are You Ready to Elevate Your Career?
Apply now and be part of a team that celebrates diversity, champions innovation, and prioritises your success.
At MHA, we know that diversity, inclusion, and belonging lead to better decisions, stronger performance, and a workplace where everyone can feel included and thrive. That's why we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.
Disability Confident
We are a Disability Confident employer. If you have a disability and meet the essential criteria for the role, we will progress you to the next stage of the process.
If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process to help you perform at your best, please let us know and we will be happy to help.

The role

As a Graduate Compliance Monitoring Associate at Trading 212 UK, you'll start your career in a second line of defence team at one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platforms. You'll help deliver the annual risk-based Compliance Monitoring Plan (CCMP): carrying out monitoring tests under supervision, recording findings clearly and helping track remediation through to completion.
This is an entry-level role with structured training. You'll build a solid understanding of FCA rules and how controls work in practice, with a clear path to Compliance Monitoring Associate as your experience grows.
What you’ll do

•
Carry out assigned monitoring tests under the Compliance Monitoring Plan, following documented procedures and completing them on time.

•
Extract and check data, select samples and keep clear, complete evidence for each test.

•
Draft findings, recommended actions and management responses for review by a senior colleague.

•
Help track open remediation actions, follow up with owners and record evidence of closure.

•
Log breaches and issues accurately and escalate anything unusual to your manager promptly.

•
Help prepare monthly monitoring MI, including completion statistics and KRIs.

•
Help keep monitoring procedures and test templates up to date.

•
Support the wider Compliance team, including Advisory, with ad hoc tasks as required.

•
Complete your training plan and build your knowledge of FCA rules, Trading 212's products and the firm's controls.

What you need to have

•
Educated to degree level (2:1 or above, or equivalent) in Law, Finance, Economics or a related field.

•
A genuine interest in financial services regulation and compliance; an internship or work experience in financial services is an advantage.

•
Strong attention to detail and accuracy, with a methodical approach to checking information.

•
Clear written communication, including the ability to summarise findings concisely.

•
Good IT skills, particularly Excel or Google Sheets.

•
A self-starter attitude, with the willingness to ask questions and learn quickly.

•
Ability to work under pressure and be adaptable.

What We offer

•

## What's Your Possible?

Take on a role where your ideas, analytical thinking and ambition can make a real difference, helping shape a secure and evolving energy future.

As a Digital Trading Graduate, you'll rotate across teams involved in systematic and algorithmic trading, gaining hands-on experience of how technology, data and operational controls support trading activity across fast-moving energy markets. You'll develop an understanding of trading processes, data quality, technology platforms and regulatory controls while contributing to initiatives that improve performance and efficiency.

This is an excellent opportunity for graduates who enjoy working with technology, analysing data and solving complex problems. You'll gain broad exposure to both commercial and technical aspects of energy trading while developing specialist knowledge that can lead to future careers in Digital Trading, Trading Technology or related disciplines.

## What Will You Do?

- Rotate across Trading, Development and IT teams to understand how technology, data and operational processes combine to support successful trading activities.
- Perform quality assurance activities on data, processes and controls, identifying exceptions and ensuring issues are escalated appropriately.
- Analyse datasets and operational information to identify trends, inconsistencies and opportunities for process improvement.
- Maintain accurate documentation, audit trails and records relating to analysis, controls, process changes and operational activities.
- Investigate and help resolve issues relating to digital and algorithmic trading systems and tools.
- Contribute to projects that improve the efficiency, reliability and effectiveness of Digital Trading processes and controls.
- Collaborate with colleagues across Trading, Quantitative Research, Technology, Risk and Compliance teams to better understand business requirements and market operations.
- Gain exposure to regulatory controls and governance requirements that support responsible trading activities.
- Take ownership of your learning and development, applying new skills and knowledge throughout the graduate programme.

## What Will You Bring?

We're looking for curious, analytical and technically-minded graduates who enjoy understanding how technology can be used to solve business challenges. You'll have a natural interest in data, systems and financial or energy markets, alongside a willingness to learn and develop in a fast-moving commercial environment.

You'll ideally have:

- A Bachelor's or Master's degree, completed or due to be completed before the programme starts, in Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science or another quantitative discipline.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues, interpret data and draw logical conclusions.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow defined processes while maintaining accurate records and documentation.
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Excel and other tools used to analyse, manipulate and present data.
- An interest in developing technical skills in areas such as SQL, Python, software development, data engineering or data visualisation. Previous coding experience would be beneficial but is not essential.
- Strong communication skills, with the confidence to explain findings, issues and recommendations clearly to different audiences.
- Good judgement and a responsible approach to controls, governance and risk management.
- The ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across Trading, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Data teams.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high-quality work.
- A genuine interest in energy markets, digital innovation and the role of technology in improving trading performance and decision-making.
- Curiosity, adaptability and a strong desire to continuously learn and develop new skills throughout your career.

Applications are open until 16 December 2026. After the application deadline, no further submissions will be accepted.

SEFE employs over 2,000 people worldwide and is owned by the Federal Government of Germany.

Securing energy – now and for the future.

In return we offer a competitive salary supported by a comprehensive range of financial, lifestyle and wellness benefits with the flexibility to follow a hybrid working model.

- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays and volunteering days
- Buy / sell holidays
- Life assurance
- Medical and dental insurance (family cover)
- Range of optional flexible benefits

Overview

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.

Our 2027 Trading Operations Analyst Programme (OA) is a 6‑month rotational programme for soon‑to‑be and recent graduates. This programme provides a blend of education, skill building, and exposure to Susquehanna and the financial services industry. It will prepare you for a full‑time position that immediately impacts Susquehanna’s business. Through 4‑week rotations you will have the opportunity to gain exposure to every desk within Trading Operations such as Trade Support, Risk Operations, Stock Loan and Settlements. Once the programme is complete, you will be placed on a fast‑paced desk that directly impacts Susquehanna's performance.

This role is based in the UK; however, the first three months of the programme (September to December 2027) will take place in our Dublin office as part of an immersive graduate training experience. During this time, you will join peers from across Europe for in‑depth learning and hands‑on development before returning to the UK to complete the programme. You will have the necessary support to make this transition smooth and focused on your learning and development.
Our Programme:

As a Trading Operations Analyst you will be exposed to the full life cycle of Susquehanna’s trading activity and develop a fundamental understanding of the industry and trading environment which Susquehanna operates in. Trading Operations work at the intersection of trading, technology, and external counterparties, where you are empowered to develop strong relationships and work on exciting, valuable projects which have real impact and contribute to our success. Working alongside our team you will develop an in‑depth exposure to all the different trading desks and business areas at Susquehanna with each rotation incorporating hands‑on experience and real‑time projects to add value.

If you have a keen interest in the financial markets, collaborating with traders while up‑skilling technically then Trading Operations could be the role for you.
What we're looking for
• Problem Solver: You enjoy solving puzzles and love when you discover a solution to difficult problems. You’re not afraid to discuss ideas and work with others to find the optimal solution.
• Communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with. You enjoy sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts and listening to the views of others.
• Ambitious: You constantly set yourself goals in life and give your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics or another passion you have, you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential.
• Numerical & Logical: When it comes to decision making, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data to come up with sensible solutions.
• Curious: You’re eager to find out more about what it’s like to work in the Finance sector, and specifically Trading Operations. Have a passion and identifiable interest in the financial markets and current affairs.
• Soon‑to‑be or recent graduate: Our programme starts in early September 2027.
What's in it for you:
• Education: Susquehanna’s in‑house education programme is widely recognised as being the best in the industry. You will attend regular seminars to learn about in‑house business, products, and tech (Excel, SQL, Python etc.).
• Support: You will be assigned a mentor from our trading operations team for each of your rotations. You will also be assigned a buddy who was a previous OA to guide you along the way.
• Real Impact: You will work collaboratively with the technology team and traders on your desk to develop trade ideas and provide real‑time opinions throughout the trading day. You will collaborate on daily tasks and improvements which are key to the ongoing success of the business.
• Culture: Our culture allows employees of every level to thrive. We are not your typical trading firm – the environment is casual, collaborative and we focus on continuous development, no matter how long you’ve been in Susquehanna.
Interview Process:

Apply > Recruiter Interview > Interview > Final Interview > Offer

If you would like to read what our Trading Operations Analysts say about working in Susquehanna, check out the Meet Our Team page on our website: https://sig.com/about/team/
Final tip - We hire for this programme on a rolling basis, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early.

Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us.

### Graduate Programme Overview

If you're a recent graduate or soon-to-be graduate join us and unlock a world of carefully curated experiences, knowledge, and connections to shape your career. Our graduates are a vital part of our success, and we welcome applications from people from all walks of life. Whoever you are and wherever you want to join us, if you’re curious, creative and ambitious, this is a world in which you can truly belong.

### Why the Private Bank & Wealth Management Graduate Programme?

Our two-year Explorer programme develops your understanding and expertise through a deep exploration of three vital areas: Product, Strategy/Business Management and Relationship Management. You’ll gain international exposure to our business and build a close relationship with the Corporate and Investment Bank, as you help our clients build on their achievements and fulfil their potential.

### Private Bank & Wealth Management at Barclays

Barclays Private Bank works closely with high-net-worth clients and their advisors who have complex banking and investment needs, both in the UK and across the world. We are here to understand their situation and their aspirations, so we can help them to reach their goals. We harness a global network of knowledge, expertise and professional partners to meet our clients’ unique requirements. Whatever they want to achieve, our Private Bankers and specialists create the personalised solutions that will help them achieve it.

### Who we're looking for

To be considered for this programme, you must be motivated and curious with a degree or expected degree, in any area.

Ideally, you'll be interested in finance and business, proactive and a good communicator. We value resourcefulness, teamwork, enthusiasm and an entrepreneurial spirit, all of which might be showcased through your involvement in extracurricular activities.

Barclays will accept applications from candidates who require immigration sponsorship to work in Jersey and, where appropriate, will support successful applicants with the necessary work permit and immigration application, subject to eligibility requirements under Jersey immigration legislation and policy. Successful applicants who are not eligible for employer-sponsored immigration permission, and for whom such permission cannot be obtained, will be required to have their own legal right to work in Jersey on a full-time basis from August 2027 to August 2029.

Barclays is required to confirm your legal Right to Work in Jersey prior to commencing employment. Please note that you do not require a Jersey work permit if any of the following applies:

- You are a British or Irish citizen or a British subject with the right of abode
- You are an EU or EEA passport holder who has been granted settled or pre-settled status
- You are a non-EU or non-EEA passport holder who has been granted settled or pre-settled statue by virtue of a relationship to an EU or EEA passport holder
- You are a Commonwealth citizen admitted on the grounds of UK ancestry
- You are a Commonwealth citizen with a certificate of entitlement to the right of abode
- You are a participant in the Youth Mobility Scheme
- You are a minister of religion
- You are a business visitor
- You are a non-EU or EEA passport holder who has no restrictions attached to your stay

Please refer to the Government of Jersey website for further information regarding work permits. From an Immigration Perspective, Barclays is required to confirm your legal Right to Remain in Jersey under the Jersey Immigration Rules.

Please note that, in addition to any immigration requirements set out above, employment in Jersey is also subject to local residential and employment status requirements under the Control of Housing and Work (Jersey) Law 2012.

You will be required to provide Barclays with details of your status under the Control of Housing and Work (Jersey) Law 2012, prior to commencing employment.

### Working in Jersey

Working in Jersey offers a unique opportunity to start your career in a thriving and dynamic financial services industry. For the first time, we're excited to offer graduate opportunities in Jersey, giving you the chance to build your career while experiencing island life in a vibrant and supportive community.

Our scheme’s provide exposure to a growing financial sector, where you'll work alongside experienced professionals, develop valuable skills, and gain insight into a wide range of banking and wealth management services. Beyond the workplace, Jersey offers an exceptional quality of life, combining a successful business environment with beautiful coastlines, outdoor activities, and a strong sense of community.

Whether you're learning, networking, collaborating, or developing your career, Jersey provides the perfect environment to grow both professionally and personally.

### Purpose of the role

description:
Alpha Bank London Limited is seeking a Graduate KYC Analyst to join the Bank’s KYC Operations team. With guidance and training, you will support Customer Due Diligence (CDD), periodic reviews and screening activities for both individual and corporate client relationships.

This 3-month Fixed-Term Contract (FTC) offers an opportunity for recent graduates or early-career candidates to develop in KYC, AML, and Financial Crime Operations within a supportive banking environment.

Qualifications
• Recent degree or equivalent qualification; applications are welcomed from candidates without previous KYC experience.
• Interest in KYC, AML, financial crime prevention, banking or financial services, with a willingness to learn.
• Basic awareness of AML, CDD, sanctions, PEP or adverse media screening would be helpful, but full training will be provided.
• Confidence learning new systems and following defined procedures accurately.
• Good analytical, research and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel.
• A proactive and organised approach, with the ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines and ask for support when needed.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Greek language skills would be advantageous but are not essential.

Responsibilities
• Support periodic KYC and CDD reviews for individual and corporate clients, under the guidance of experienced team members.
• Review client documents and information for completeness and accuracy, escalating gaps or inconsistencies where required.
• Carry out sanctions, PEP, adverse media and financial crime screening checks using the Bank’s systems and procedures.
• Assist with assessing client risk profiles and identifying potential AML, sanctions and financial crime concerns for escalation.
• Maintain accurate client records and help complete review activities within agreed timescales.
• Work collaboratively with Relationship Managers, Compliance and other colleagues to obtain information and resolve queries.
• Support basic management information reporting, record keeping and data quality checks.
• Contribute ideas to improve team processes and operational efficiency as knowledge and experience develop.
• Support wider Bank projects and team activities as required, while prioritising core KYC responsibilities.
